status: Registration, active-account and account-change services verified against unchanged upstream register.ts/announcement.ts through an injected service port; native rpi register_service binding pending
compared: register.ts announce timing: one emit per registration call, one per installed session_start handler, in call order
register.ts event name pi-multiprovider:register and value identity (every emit is the exact integration object)
Descriptor projection of id/label and optional managementHint/selectionBias, with absent fields staying absent
Consumer inventory: last value per id at the first registration position; a repeated id is announced again and the session-start replay keeps the value that call supplied
announcement.ts getActiveAccount: explicit pin, implicit affinity selection, upstream account, stale pin and missing integration
announcement.ts resolveActiveAccountAuth: stored credential source, bearer header extraction, resolver failure, blank token and upstream-account suppression
Session context and cancellation signal crossing the service call into the integration
onActiveAccountChanged fan-out per provider, unsubscribe, and a throwing listener isolated from siblings
Account inventory whitelist (id/label/authKind) in integration order; unknown provider is null and inventory failure propagates
Host envelope validation (version, service id, serviceVersion, method type, malformed JSON) with {version:1,error} replies
Manifest shape, identifier alphabet/limits, method/topic uniqueness and exact manifest fields
Publication order/sequence for providerRegistered, providerUnregistered and activeAccountChanged; idempotent unregister
Publication failure propagates while keeping local inventory and notifying in-process listeners first
notTested: The native binary: this package still has no rpi extension entrypoint, so register_service, the extern callback, string ownership and native_request publish are exercised only through the injected Port trait.
Host subscription lifecycle (subscribe/next/unsubscribe, 64-event/4 MiB bounds, owner unload, backpressure) is host infrastructure and is not re-tested here.
Real native-library loading, session assembly and Linux/macOS/Windows execution.
A compatible Fabric consumer (M09) and combined packages.
The 27-case announcement differential suite already covered by tests/announcement.rs is not duplicated; this suite replays the 6 upstream spec scenarios plus native-only envelope/publication cases.
Topic payload shapes are the native contract mapping of upstream event values; upstream has no wire equivalent to compare them against.
bindingGaps: src/native/mod.rs has no plugin register entrypoint (owned by m-native); it must call register_service with manifest_json() and route the callback through NativeServices::respond.

The service callback is synchronous: the binding must block on respond() on a runtime it owns, copy the returned JSON into an SDK-owned StbString, and honour AuthRequestControl cancellation as a CancellationToken.
Port::publish must call native_request {port:'services',action:'publish',service,serviceVersion,topic,value} and return the committed sequence; the current Port trait is the only host-facing seam.

A session context source (MultiProviderServiceContext equivalent: model, modelRegistry/sessionManager lookups) and the integration/base-provider/affinity-key lookups must be wired by the extension; m-native does not exist yet.
m-native must call register_provider for each registerMultiProvider integration and session_start on each session start; unregister_provider is native-only.
